hero_h1: A new cosmetic and implant center

about_heading: Built for complex cosmetic and implant work
about_body:
Esthetique Dentistry of Ashburn is owned by Dr. Sanjeev Bhatia and Dr. Hemani Kaur. The Ashburn center is newly built and opened in April 2026.

It was designed around the work it does: implants, prosthodontics and full-mouth reconstruction, with sedation available for patients who need it. Complex cases stay in one place, with one team, from plan to finish.

services.name: Cosmetic dentistry
services.blurb: Cosmetic treatment planned for the finished look, not just the individual tooth.

services.name: Dental implants
services.blurb: Implant placement and restoration, from a single tooth through to a full arch.

services.name: Full-mouth reconstruction
services.blurb: Prosthodontic rebuilds for patients whose teeth need restoring as one plan.

services.name: Sedation dentistry
services.blurb: Sedation options for anxious patients and for longer treatment appointments.

footer_tagline: Cosmetic, implant and reconstructive dentistry in Ashburn, Virginia.
why_this_angle: Anchored on the newly built Ashburn center and its April 2026 opening from growth_trigger, paired with the prosthodontics and sedation detail in specialty that sets it apart from a general practice.
